title: Black Women Drinking Wine Clipart PNG
author: Deanna McRae
description:
This set contains 5 gorgeous hand-drawn natural hair black women drinking wine.
-5 fully colored clip art images in PNG format
-Each file is about 3600 pixels Tall / 300 DPI.
Images have transparent backgrounds and may be used in a variety of projects including brochures, post cards, business cards, websites, planner stickers, stationary, calendars, posters, scrapbooks and much more.
